statement: Linux hid-wiimote's hotplug worker reinitializes extension and MotionPlus register spaces, detects attachment identity and then maps MotionPlus into the primary extension register window only if MP_USED was present in its state snapshot. The mapping write targets A600FE with mode 0x04 for standalone, 0x05 for Nunchuk-style and 0x07 for Classic-style pass-through. If MP_USED is absent, the worker leaves MotionPlus unmapped and schedules polling as applicable; releasing the last MotionPlus input-node open clears MP_USED, prompting remapping/deactivation rather than maintaining a user-independent gyro stream.

applicability.revision: Linux hid-wiimote v6.12 and mainline 734bef5; source behavior, no host runtime
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. Core v6.12 wiimote_cmd_init_mp 467-485, wiimote_cmd_map_mp 488-510, wiimote_init_hotplug 1095-1192; mainline 467-508 and 1095-1190. Modules MP close callback. Physical transaction timing not measured.
